answer: To resist Sybils, an agent economy roots identity in an attestation thread where nodes verify work histories using zero-knowledge proofs. Validating an agent's ledger entry anchors its trust atlas, making it impossible to forge verifiable credentials. Instead of linear staking, validation requires stake scaling as $O(k^2)$, imposing exponential capital exhaustion that bankrupts any expanding Sybil swarm attempting network dominance.
